name: classroom-day

name: snow-night
prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. name: canteen-day
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Windows are sunlit with soft shadows; no blue night, no fluorescent lamps glowing. Quiet empty room ready for lunch, no people, no figures, no posters, no menu writing, no signs, no readable text, no watermarks.
